outreach.notes: Joint winner (with Aurion Service) of the EXPO Village accommodation-operator contract: RSD 234.6m ex-VAT, covering the 1,500-unit residential complex for official and unofficial participants — staffing, reservations, reception, guest communication. Belgrade hospitality operator; runs Crowne Plaza Belgrade; owned by Fenix Development. Directly relevant to our where-to-stay leg as well as the Expo leg. Source: tanjug.rs/expo-2027/vesti/271466 + biznis.rs (2026-08-05). Website not verified from an official source.
